Repository to share the data and code associated with the scientific article Istrate et al. Future environmental performance of lithium from brines shaped by energy and reagent decarbonization and technology optimization (Environmental Science & Technology). The repository contains data files and code to create prospective life cycle inventory (LCI) databases that implement future scenarios for battery-grade lithium carbonate production from brines.
